_metadata.label: CONTROLLED_SYNTHETIC_EVALUATION_DATA
_metadata.disclaimer: SYNTHETIC EVALUATION DATA ONLY. Used for algorithmic verification under controlled conditions. Does not represent production field telemetry or commercial claims.

cases.name: Verified Effective Resolution (Zero Recurrence)
cases.rationale: 100% reduction in observations over 7 days post-intervention indicates verified fix.

cases.name: Ineffective Remediation (Rapid Recurrence)
cases.rationale: Post-intervention complaints increased; technician intervention failed to resolve root cause.

cases.name: Insufficient Observation Period (Inconclusive / Cannot Yet Be Determined)
cases.rationale: Only 2 hours elapsed since resolution; must state outcome cannot yet be determined to prevent premature victory.

cases.name: No Significant Operational Change
cases.rationale: Post-intervention complaint rate identical to pre-intervention baseline.
